name: UQ LGBTQIA+ Scholarship
summary: Scholarship for UQ students who identify as LGBTQIA+, show commitment to the community, and face financial hardship.
who: Identify as a member of the LGBTQIA+ community.
Enrolled, or will be, in an approved program in the semester of the award.
Can demonstrate financial hardship with documents.
Can demonstrate commitment to the LGBTQIA+ community, and haven't received it before.
how: Apply with supporting documents such as references, your Centrelink statement or ATO notice, and your academic transcript.
catches: Value varies. UQ doesn't publish a fixed amount.

evidence.quote: identify as a member of the LGBTQIA+ community
can demonstrate financial hardship by providing documentary evidence
